prompt: Photorealistic full-length studio photograph of one woman of about 35 in a 1912 evening gown: a high-waisted narrow column silhouette in pale champagne silk satin with a sheer chiffon overlay, a satin sash just under the bust, short sleeves, long white kid gloves above the elbow, an ankle-length hem showing satin evening shoes; her hair is swept up in a soft Edwardian updo with a jewelled hair ornament. The whole body from the top of the head to the soles of the feet is in frame, front view, facing the camera, standing in a relaxed A-pose with the arms held a little away from the body, empty open hands, feet slightly apart and fully visible. Plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadows, no props, no text, no logos. Historically accurate 1912 Edwardian clothing and hair, a natural realistic face, sharp fabric detail.
